title: Compact-uniform Whitney remainder on a closed subset of almost full measure (η_k step of Simon Ch. 2, Thm 1.5)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let g : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be Lipschitz with constant K ≥ 0. Let C ⊆ ℝⁿ be closed such that g is Fréchet differentiable at every x ∈ C and Dg = fderiv ℝ g : ℝⁿ → (ℝⁿ)* is continuous on C. Let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a closed set A ⊆ C with Lⁿ(C ∖ A) < ε (Lⁿ = volume) with the following property. For every compact L ⊆ A and every δ > 0 there is ρ > 0 such that |g(y) − g(x) − Dg(x)(y − x)| ≤ δ|y − x| for all x ∈ L and y ∈ A with |x − y| < ρ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K g → ∀ C : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed C → (∀ x ∈ C, DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) → ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ g) C → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed A ∧ A ⊆ C ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ L : Set (Eucl n), IsCompact L → L ⊆ A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ A, dist x y < ρ → ‖g y - g x - fderiv ℝ g x (y - x)‖ ≤ δ * ‖y - x‖
